annotations.title: Swap one item of a Trip720 trip

description: Replaces one line of an option with one of the numbered choices from trip_alternatives, and re-prices the whole trip as the website does. Returns the updated option and its Safe Trip Total before and after. Side effect: the trip saved on Trip720 changes; the previous choice can be chosen again the same way. Nothing is booked or paid.

choice.description: The number of the choice from trip_alternatives.
